content.title: Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) Delivers Impressive Q3 CY2025
content.summary: Insurance brokerage firm Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 35.4% year on year to $1.61 billion largely due to M&A and profit-sharing contingent commissions.
